welcome.title: Your 3D models, organized like a photo library
welcome.lead: Meshkeep indexes the STL, OBJ and 3MF files already on your disks. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is moved without asking, and your metadata lives next to your files.
welcome.addRootHint: Pick the folder where your models live. Subfolders are scanned as projects.
welcome.footer: Offline by design. You can add more folders later in Settings.
welcome.importHint: Zips from Printables, MakerWorld or Thingiverse become projects; loose files go to the inbox.

scan.title: 1 · Scan
scan.body: Folders with model files become projects. Nothing is moved or written.

thumbs.title: 2 · Previews
thumbs.body: Thumbnails render in the background and live in the app cache.

sidecar.title: 3 · Metadata
sidecar.body: Tags, creator and notes go into a project.yaml next to the files, only when you edit.

library.emptyFiltered: No project matches the current search and filters.
library.emptyRoot: This folder has no projects yet. Scan it or add files.
library.hint: Select a project to see its details here. Double-click opens it.
library.emptyFavorites: Star a project to see it here.

inspector.creator: Creator
inspector.offlineHint: {{path}} is not reachable. The project stays in the library and comes back when the drive reconnects.
inspector.multiHint: Actions apply to every selected project.

project.title: Title
project.creator: Creator
project.saveHint: Changes are written to project.yaml automatically, a second after the last edit or when you leave the form. The UI updates at once; the file is written atomically.
project.viewerHint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
project.noModels: No model files in this project.
project.unsupported: Preview for {{ext}} comes later; STL, OBJ and 3MF work today.
project.conflictBody: Someone edited this file while you were working. Reload to see the external changes, or overwrite them with yours.
project.attachmentHint: Archives inside a project are kept as opaque backups. They are never extracted or browsed.
project.workerFallback: The background parser did not answer; parsing in the foreground instead (slower).

settings.title: Settings
settings.rootsHint: Folders the app indexes and may write metadata into.
settings.removeBody: Its projects disappear from the app. Nothing on disk is deleted; project.yaml files stay where they are.
settings.ignoreHint: Glob patterns excluded from scans. Changes apply on the next scan.
settings.previewsHint: Rendered in the background and cached in the data folder; never written into your library.
settings.containersHint: A folder whose models sit only in a sub-folder with one of these names (plus images or a README next to it) counts as one project. Applies on the next scan.
settings.updatesStore: Updates arrive through the Microsoft Store.
settings.updatesPrivate: Private build: checks GitHub Releases on request.
settings.updateNone: You are on the latest version.
settings.updateIdle: Updates are never installed without asking.
settings.updatesDevChannel: Dev channel: every push to main becomes a build; checked once on startup.
settings.updateDevHint: Dev channel build. Installs in the background and restarts the app.
settings.thumbLocationHintApp: Nothing is written into your library. Previews are lost on reinstall and re-rendered.
settings.thumbLocationHintProject: Written to <project>\\.cache\\thumbs so previews travel with the folder (also into zips and backups). Not indexed, never a thumbnail source.
settings.notificationsHint: Windows toasts when a background scan or an import finishes while Meshkeep is not the active window.
settings.feedbackHint: Found a bug or have an idea? Reports open as prefilled GitHub issues; nothing is sent in the background.

errors.sidecar_conflict: project.yaml changed on disk. Reload before saving.
errors.root_offline: This library folder is offline right now.
errors.not_found: Not found. The library may have changed; try a rescan.
errors.root_exists: This folder is already a library root.
errors.not_a_directory: That path is not a folder.
errors.invalid_name: That name is not allowed as a folder name.
errors.already_exists: A file or folder with that name already exists.
errors.not_allowed: This action is not allowed here.

actions.renameBody: The folder on disk is renamed. Tags and metadata in project.yaml are kept.
actions.deleteBody: The whole project folder goes to the recycle bin. You can restore it from there.
actions.deleteFileBody: Only this file is moved. The project keeps its other files and metadata.
actions.projectGone: The folder no longer contains a model and left the library.

import.title: Import
import.lead: Review what each dropped item becomes. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.name: Project folder
import.done: Imported {{projects}} projects, {{inbox}} files to the inbox
import.dropHint: Archives and folders become projects, single files go to the inbox

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.hint: Loose files in {{path}}. Select some and turn them into a project.
inbox.emptyHint: Drop single model files onto the app or choose “Inbox” in the import dialog; they land here until you turn them into projects.
inbox.promoteBody: A new project folder is created directly below the library root and the files move there.

collections.title: Collections
collections.nameBody: A collection is an ordered list of projects, independent of folders. Stored in the app data, not in your library.
collections.name: Name
collections.deleteBody: Only the collection is removed. Projects and files stay where they are.
collections.emptyHint: Right-click a project to add it to a collection, or save a search as a smart collection.
collections.emptyCollection: This collection is empty. Right-click a project → Add to collection.
collections.emptySmart: No project matches this smart collection right now.
collections.saveSmartHint: Save the current search, tags and scope as a smart collection
collections.newSmartBody: The current search text, tags, favorites and folder scope are saved and evaluated live every time you open it.

notify.importBodyInbox: Files were added to the inbox

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.body: Your report opens as a prefilled issue on GitHub in your browser. You can still edit everything there before posting; a GitHub account is needed.

summaryHint.bug: What goes wrong, in one line

detailsHint.bug: What did you do, what did you expect, what happened instead?
detailsHint.idea: The problem you want to solve and how you imagine it working.

feedback.includeLogHint: The last {{lines}} log lines are copied to the clipboard; paste them into the "Log excerpt" field. User folders are shortened to ~.
feedback.publicNote: Issues on GitHub are public. Please check the text and the log for anything you would rather not share.
feedback.opened: The issue form opened in your browser.
feedback.openedWithLog: The issue form opened in your browser; the log excerpt is on your clipboard.
